# Repository instructions

Follow `/AGENTS.md` for permanent engineering and workflow rules.

Before changing code, read:

1. `/docs/current-phase.md` for the only currently authorized implementation scope.
2. `/docs/architecture.md` for technical boundaries.
3. `/docs/product-spec.md` for product requirements relevant to the task.
4. `/README.md` for the verified local workflow.

Inspect the current implementation before creating or replacing files. Do not treat roadmap items or historical handoff sections as authorization to implement future phases. Never invent real wedding data or expose secrets. Use pnpm and run the relevant lint, typecheck, build, and test commands before claiming success.
